Reproduction_Steps: Inspect APK via aapt2 dump badging; flags application-debuggable is present; signed with debug keystore (CN=Android Debug, O=Android, C=US).
Remediation: Create production release signing key; configure release buildType with signingConfig and isMinifyEnabled = true in build.gradle.kts.

Summary: R8 code shrinking and ProGuard obfuscation disabled
Reproduction_Steps: Inspect buildTypes.release: isMinifyEnabled is false, optimization.enable is false. Classes and method names fully decompilable.
Remediation: Enable isMinifyEnabled = true, isShrinkResources = true, and configure proguard-rules.pro for Kotlin Coroutines, Compose, and Firebase.

Summary: Dual-storage desync for auto-sync setting (SharedPreferences vs Firestore UserProfile)
Reproduction_Steps: UpiNotificationListenerService reads local SharedPreferences 'auto_sync_enabled_$uid', whereas web portal updates Firestore 'users/{uid}.autoSyncEnabled'.
Remediation: Listen to Firestore user document snapshot in Android application or synchronize SharedPreferences on app resume to keep states unified.

Summary: Intentional deletion of all transactions triggers re-seeding of demo transactions
Reproduction_Steps: If user deletes every transaction, transactions collection becomes empty. Next app startup detects transactions.isEmpty() and calls seedInitialTransactions().
Remediation: Store a persistent boolean flag 'has_seeded_initial_data' in UserProfile or SharedPreferences so seeding occurs strictly once per account lifecycle.

Summary: Redundant source code mirror and historical staging directories present in repository
Reproduction_Steps: Folder source_code duplicates app/src/main/java; REVIEW_BEFORE_DELETE contains 97 historical files, obsolete APKs (liferece-4.apk), and scripts.
Remediation: Archive REVIEW_BEFORE_DELETE to external backup; remove redundant source_code directory so developers only maintain android_project.

Summary: Notification Listener Service lacks in-app prompt or direct intent to Settings screen
Reproduction_Steps: Android 13+ requires user to manually grant Notification Listener permission in OS Special App Access. App switch toggles local flag without opening settings intent.
Remediation: Add helper intent: startActivity(Intent(Settings.ACTION_NOTIFICATION_LISTENER_SETTINGS)) when user enables Auto-Sync if permission is missing.

Summary: Static sample receipt drawables bundled in APK increase download size to 28.66 MB
Reproduction_Steps: APK includes baked_goods_1.jpg (61 KB), baked_goods_2.jpg (63 KB), and baked_goods_3.jpg (88 KB).
Remediation: Remove sample test receipt JPEGs from production release build variant.

Summary: Target SDK set to API 36 (Android 16 Developer Preview)
Reproduction_Steps: targetSdk is configured as 36. While forward-compatible, Google Play production requirements currently mandate targetSdk 34 (Android 14) or 35 (Android 15).
Remediation: Validate targetSdk against Google Play Store policy prior to submission; test runtime permissions on Android 14/15 devices.
